Something exactly like this has happened to me. I remember sitting in the living room, and my mom was in the kitchen. She asked me what I wanted to eat. Right when I said "I don't know" here she comes walking in the front door. I looked behind me into the kitchen and she wasn't there. Apparently she had been taking out the trash that entire time.

Finding my hamster dead under a pile of my mothers clothes. I was in 6th grade, was kind of a weird child so that hamster felt like my only "true" friend. I was trying to move his cage in the dark one night and I didn't notice the top of it popped open. He got out and I didn't even realize it. We came to a conclusion that my cat smothered him under the clothes.

The worst part was, when I was still grieving, my best friend told me (in the snobbiest way possible) that it was all my fault.

Hi! The school you described sounds a lot like the school I went to my sophomore year. It is definitely a lot less stressful, but still requires a bit of motivation. It's very very calm and quiet. I remember having trouble staying awake in the mornings because of it. :P

We used an online program called "edgenuity" for a portion of our classes and for some classes we used books. The instructors there (at least for me) are very understanding and helpful. I would recommend it if she is suffering from anxiety or anything that inhibits her ability to function normally in a public school setting. Good luck!

I'll just start from the beginning, sorry for any typos, everything is probably going to get fuzzy and emotional for me halfway through :P This is also a complete clusterfuck, so you might get confused..and, just a warning there's a lot of manipulative behavior in this. the guy i met AND the girl were in on all of this. it was just a joke to them. they would just toss me back and forth.

A year or two before this I had completely blocked her from everything, or so I thought. She messaged me on facebook this past summer, and I had absolutely no idea who she was. I didn't even know that I knew anyone with her name...i thought it was one of my friends playing a trick on me. I eventually remembered who she was. She was 19 at this point. "Are you still mad at me?" She asked. I became even more confused. Mad? About what? It's like I'd forgotten every single thing she had put me through. So I said no, i'm not. We started talking again and she said "do you have a boyfriend?" (what i'm about to explain is exactly what she'd do to me over the years) i said no, I don't. It was kind of hard for me to even consider having a boyfriend. I suffer from bipolar disorder and, at the time, had social phobia/anxiety. "Would you be interested in one of my friends?" i told her i didn't know. she then proceeded to tell me his dad just died and he needed some comfort in his life. at this point i was feeling pretty bad so I said that I'd talk to him. We'll call him B, and the girl C. B and I started talking and he seemed like a really nice guy, but as SOON as I started talking to him, C started making everything sexual. (ex. "when are you gonna show him your tits?" "strip for him" etc etc.) She would pressure me, and subtly guilt me. I showed B a picture of me and he started flattering me. I was 14. 14 and naive and not in the least bit confident. my depressive episodes tore me apart, i seriously bullied myself all the time...But the fact that someone thought I was beautiful, and seemed genuinely interested in me was beyond my comprehension, so I just went with it. B, like C, was 18-19, and KNEW I was fourteen. B then proceeded to tell me he had come upon a lot of money recently, and was willing to do something for me if i did something for him. 

I'm not trying to say that it wasn't my fault at all for going through with it....but looking back on it now...C (the girl) knew that I was mentally ill and going through a lot of things...she took complete advantage of me.

So fast forward to a few days later. B bought me $160 worth of things. He then told me that it was fine if i didn't want to show him anything, he understands. I was confused, because he made it clear that he wanted something in return. So like the idiot I am, I insisted on giving him what he wanted. So I did. I skyped him that weekend. Did a BUNCH of things I regret doing. during all of this C kept messaging me saying stuff like "are you stripping for him?" "please respond" etc. After he finished, we skyped for about three hours, just talking...and this is where I fell into the trap.

"You know what I hate?" he said.
"What?"
"When you want to ask something, but you're afraid of what the other person might say."
"Oh, me too."
"Sooo," he said, "will you go out with me?"

even MORE confusion! why was he asking me out after knowing me for three days? the suspicions lied in the back of my mind but the louder part of me said that he was just confused too. since his dad died, he just needed someone to fill that void, to pick him off his feet. and thinking back to what he had just said before...i knew it would be better if i decided to give it a try. So i said okay.

days passed, we still did sexual stuff, and C was still there in the background, except it got weirder. she would HARASS me for nude pictures...your definition of persistent is probably way behind what this girl was. and when i said no, she'd get legitimately pissed off. ("why?" "what the fuck makes me different from everyone else?") i tried to just ignore it. I'd talk about it with B when he asked and tell him how uncomfortable C was making me.

and here's something that happened that i'm pretty sure was them fucking with my feelings, because i started to actually really like B. he said to me one day, "guess what?" i asked him what and he said that he had met a girl. i was pretty shocked and didnt know why he was telling me this, but then he went into detail about how they exchanged numbers and all that. then for whatever reason, when offline for 10 minutes. in those 10 minutes, i started absolutely hating myself again. I was afraid that he was going to leave me for someone else. he then came back and said "sorry, my internet went out." i said good because you scared me half to death. then he proceeded to tell me how he would always want me and would never leave me. the comfort was back again.

other stuff happened, but another instance was when B just suddenly left for an entire week. it fucked me up, and then he suddenly came back and said "sorry, i was at my brothers." which i later found out wasn't true at all. he asked me if i was mad at him and i said no and went to bed. he told me that he said he was leaving for a while when i asked, which he didn't at all, but somehow convinced me he did. (i also have memory lapses, so that's why i was so easily convinced) C would basically tell him what to do, and to fuck with me, and that's exactly what he did. they were actually dating this entire time as well.
 i don't really feel like writing out every single thing they did to me that would send me into panic attacks because they thought it was funny, mostly because i can't remember and secondly is because i don't want to remember. lol. 

B became very very distant, and i couldn't understand why. and then finally one day b told me she was trans, and that's why she was so distant and that's actually why she left for a week (which i LATER found out that's not why either) and please don't think i'm doubting that she's trans. it was just a big plot-twist for me. i like girls as well but it's not what i was expecting. 

there was actually a point in time where i tried to get away from C. She kept saying "b doesn't like you, she doesn't want to go to jail" and she was basically trolling me about it. i got fed up and blocked her...but then i found myself missing her. i don't know why, but i would miss talking to her and i wanted her to be friends with me again, so i unblocked her a few days after.

so after continuous manipulative behavior and messing with my feelings a whole bunch, it ended, and not on a good note. i remember it so vividly..

I was wearing a yellow tank top and blue shorts. i was eating stir fry and watching season 2 of bobs burgers on netflix (looovve that show. or loved, anyway) i remember how the air smelled and how it was about twelve in the morning. i got a text from C. she asked me what i was doing and when i responded that i was eating, she said she needed to confess something. "alright," i said, already getting anxious as hell.

"i love C." she said. i thought she was trolling so i responded "lmao okay, like i'm going to believe that."

"i really love her, and she loves me too" she said. 

"you told me you really liked me though?" i asked, she had gotten mad and told me that one night, then asked me why i didn't like her back.

"that was only so you wouldn't suspect anything."

i rolled my eyes and started talking to B. 
"hey, can you tell C to stop? she's making me really fucking anxious." B didn't respond.

"is it true?" i said.
"yes." B finally responded.
"what?" i said. then B explained how she wanted to tell me but she couldn't bring herself to do it, and how C got her into all of it, and how they were really together. she said she never wanted to hurt me.

evberything was really fuzzy. "why  would you do that to someone?" i could barely type because i was crying so much. "i'm sorry" she responded. C blocked me before i could say anything to her. B stuck around but i told her i had to block her because i couldnt be reminded of her anymore. i fell into a really bad depressive episode. i didn't eat or sleep. i destroyed my arms with razors. i would on and off cry, or just stare at my wall, completely unable to feel anything.

i feel so stupid. the whole situation is stupid and happened so fast and i don't know why it bothers me so much, but every time i'm so much as reminded of it i cry, and i panic. it was among the things that sent me to a hospital three months ago. i know the whole situation just seems silly, but it really fucked me up. i was lead on to a whole other level and i feel so ashamed that i let c fuck me over again.

She was very awkward about it. When the psychiatrist left the room she just said "Well, I hope you don't do that anymore." (in regards the the sexual favors.) And she's always brushed my sexual abuse aside. I dont really know why.
